notes.title: (UPDATE) WIN A HOTEL BARCELONA JACKET SIGNED BY SWERY & SUDA51
notes.content:
HOTEL BARCELONA's Steam Next Fest demo is OUT NOW. June 9 - 16.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2286600/HOTEL_BARCELONA/"][/dynamiclink]

Beat boss Jacob in the Next Fest demo and be in with the chance of winning a custom HOTEL BARCELONA varsity jacket signed by SWERY and SUDA51. Screenshot your victory and send it to us with the hashtag #BeatBossJacob. Hell yeah.



We announced the competition yesterday and some of you have managed to slaughter Jacob already...?! HOLY SH*T. Hats off, you sadomasochists!!!



Already entered? FYI: We're updating the method to enter the competition. Chalk it down to monsters eating your screenshots (we should've expected nothing less from the Hotel Barcelona's usual clientele) but annoyingly we can't see all of your entries and yeah, it's weird. As such, HERE'S THE UPDATED METHOD TO ENTER THE COMPETITION:


HOW TO ENTER:[olist]
Play the demo on Steam between June 9 – 16

Defeat Jacob, the first boss

Take a screenshot proving your win

Post it in the official Steam Community Hub Discussion page with a link to your screenshot and/or social media

Add the hashtag #BeatBossJacob

Done. You’re entered.
[/olist]
We'll draw a winner at random from valid entries after the demo closes.


THE PRIZE:
Custom HOTEL BARCELONA varsity jacket

Signed by SWERY and SUDA51



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/4z4FwVb.jpeg"]



IMPORTANT STUFF:

Must be 18+ to enter

Open to United Kingdom, European Union (excluding Italy), Japan, United States, and Canada (excluding Quebec)

One entry per person

Winners announced June 21

Full terms: https://thecultgames.prezly.com/hotel-barcelona

Valve/Steam is not involved in this contest. We’re just using this space to feel the burn together.


NEED HELP BEATING JACOB?
This ain't a game for the weak hearted, but the Steam forums are fair game for sharing tips and tactics. Just don’t fake your screenshot - we will check. And Jacob will find you.



We can't wait to see who survives.

Now go die trying.
